_readme: Where campaign adverts can go. Hand-edited catalogue; the mutable half (when we last posted, who joined from where) lives in state under recruitment_log. See scripts/recruiting/README.md.
_cooldown_source: 'rule' means the venue states it. 'assumed' means nobody has checked and the number is a conservative guess. Never shorten an assumed cooldown without reading the venue's rules first: a ban costs more than a missed week.
_fit: How well the venue matches THIS offering: free, Pathfinder 2e, play-by-post, on Telegram. A busy venue full of people wanting live voice games is a bad fit no matter how large it is.

venues.name: Pathfinder 2e Discord: looking for players as GM
venues.rules_note: The venue Lewis already uses. URL and the channel's actual repost rule still need filling in.
venues.notes: The only venue with a track record so far. Everything else in this file is unproven.

venues.name: Paizo forums: Recruitment
venues.rules_note: Paizo's own play-by-post recruitment board. Verify the sticky before the first post.
venues.notes: Best on-paper fit: official Pathfinder audience AND explicitly play-by-post. Forum threads keep pulling people in for months instead of scrolling away in an hour.

venues.name: RPG Crossing: Games Seeking Players
venues.rules_note: Read the Games Seeking Players sticky before posting.
venues.notes: 30,000+ members and built specifically around play-by-post, with Pathfinder among its supported systems. Second best on-paper fit.

venues.name: RPGnet: Roleplay-By-Post recruitment
venues.rules_note: Has a Roleplay-By-Post meta forum carrying PF2e recruitment threads.
venues.notes: Confirmed to carry PF2e play-by-post recruitment. Smaller and more general than the two above.

venues.name: reddit: r/lfg
venues.rules_note: STATED RULE: no more than one post every 24 hours. Uses a title code system, check the sidebar. Flair is 'GM and player(s) wanted' or 'Player(s) wanted'.
venues.notes: Large but dominated by live voice games, so expect a low conversion rate. The 24h cooldown is a real rule and the only one in this file that is not a guess. Posts reportedly do best Sunday evening US time.

venues.name: reddit: play-by-post subreddit
venues.rules_note: UNVERIFIED. I could not confirm the exact subreddit name or that it is active. Confirm it exists before adding it to the rotation.
venues.notes: Recorded as a lead, not a venue. Left deliberately incomplete rather than guessed at.

venues.name: Giant in the Playground: Recruitment
venues.rules_note: UNVERIFIED. Long-running play-by-post forum; PF2e activity level not checked.

venues.name: D&D Beyond forums: Looking For Group
venues.rules_note: STATED RULE: do not spam or bump unless the campaign undergoes a significant change.
venues.notes: REJECTED: a D&D 5e audience. Recorded so the decision is not re-litigated in three months.

venues.name: Roll20 Looking For Group
venues.rules_note: STATED RULE: listings must only use Roll20 to play.
venues.notes: REJECTED: the rules require the game to run on Roll20 and ours runs on Telegram. Same reason rules out the Foundry and Fantasy Grounds boards.
